method select_words(s: string, n: int) returns (result: seq<string>)
    requires n >= 0
    requires |s| >= 0
    ensures result == [] ==> |s| == 0
    ensures |result| == CountWordsWithConsonants(s, n)

predicate CountWordsWithConsonants(s: string, n: int) 
    reads s
    ensures Count(s, n) == |result| // This predicate will count the words with exactly n consonants.

predicate ContainsExactlyNConsonants(word: string, s: string, n: int)
    reads word, s
    ensures CountConsonants(word) == n // This predicate checks if `word` contains exactly n consonants.
